style: Supplier B (poultry and smallgoods distributor, dompdf PDF). Columns: Item Code | Item Description (wraps onto a SECOND line for brand/notes) | Ordered | Shipped | UOM | Ship Doc + Unit UOM | Item Price | GST | Line Total. Item Price is per UOM: per KG when UOM is KG (catch-weight bacon, chipolatas, chicken), per CTN/BAG/UNIT otherwise. Ex-GST. A FUEL LEVY line carries the only GST. Ordered and Shipped print as equal 2-decimal numbers on every line. One page.

lines.note: the '6' ends the first line and 'UNITS/CTN' wraps; from the first line alone the pack is 700g per unit and units per carton is ambiguous, so a manual row is acceptable
